description:
The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is loaded in InVesalius 3. You need to document cranial dimensions for a forensic report.

1. Navigate to the Sagittal view and use the Linear Measurement tool to measure the **Maximum Cranial Length** (anterior-to-posterior).
2. Navigate to the Coronal view and measure the **Maximum Cranial Breadth** (left-to-right).
3. Create a text file at `/home/ga/Documents/cranial_report.txt` and write these two values inside (e.g., 'Length: 180.5, Breadth: 145.2').
4. Save the InVesalius project with these measurements to `/home/ga/Documents/forensic_cranium.inv3`.

Ensure the text report contains the numeric values in millimeters.
